## Activity

During October 2020, North City Eye Clinic completed 351 captures as part of its routine screening activity. The volume recorded for the month provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issues noted in the monthly record.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading in nearly all cases. A total of 3 captures were ungradable, representing a rate of 0.9 per cent of all captures. This result indicates that only a small proportion of images could not proceed through the grading process. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring causes can be identified and addressed where appropriate.

## Grading

Grading identified 73 referable results during the month. The median lag between capture and completion of grading was 1 day. This provided a short turnaround for the review of images and the identification of results requiring referral or further clinical consideration. Overall, the monthly activity shows completed capture sessions, a low ungradable rate, and timely grading across the service.
